Lemma
[Algebraic Properties of the Hessian Operator] ↗ prop:jacobi-field-hessian-equation ↗ lem:symmetric-bilinear-form-unit-vectors 1. ch11:11.1

The operator $\mathcal H_r$ is self-adjoint, satisfies $\mathcal H_r(\partial _r)=0$, and restricts on each level set of $r$ to the shape operator with normal $N=-\partial _r$.

Proof

\sketch Symmetry of $ abla ^2r$ and (11.2) give self-adjointness. Since radial integral curves are geodesics, $ abla _{\partial _r}\partial _r=0$. Finally, $\partial _r$ is a unit normal to each level set, so the Weingarten equation identifies $ abla \partial _r$ on its tangent space with the shape operator for $-\partial _r$.

□
